reviews.text:
Sadly, last Tuesday I had to say goodbye to my beloved companion and best friend, Cocaloca.
The most compassionate way to say goodbye was through at-home euthanasia, so I contacted TomVets, who responded quickly and proved to be not only highly professional but also incredibly empathetic.
Coca said her final goodbyes in her home, lying on her favorite blanket on the sofa, surrounded by love and tranquility.
This situation is incredibly difficult and painful, but Tommaso made everything much more bearable and peaceful thanks to his attentiveness, professionalism, and incredibly humane and understanding approach.

It's a highly recommended service, one I will definitely use again in the future, especially if I adopt another cat.

Thank you so much, TomVets. Sending you a huge hug. XX
Punctual, professional and attentive.
Very professional

We found a very skittish stray kitten that had wandered into our garage. So we decided not to traumatize him any further with trips to the vet and made an appointment with TomVets. It was a very professional visit; they treated the kitten with great care and performed all the tests with minimal interaction to avoid stressing him, including disease tests, blood work, microchipping, and vaccinations. We are very happy.

I have nothing but praise for the entire TomVets team. They visit my cats, and my mother's cats too. They are patient and professional. We had to say goodbye to our 20-year-old cat, Nico, and the care they provided was exceptional. The other day, Barney got sick. Tom told us he didn't think there was anything he could do and drove my mother and Barney to a veterinary hospital where he ended up passing away. My mother is elderly, and I was working, so I couldn't go with her. The convenience, ease, and price, along with their incredibly caring team, only make me hope they continue with this innovative mobile veterinary service, which is now more than just a project—it's a well-established reality. Thank you so much for your empathy, love for animals, and incredible care, even in the most difficult times.
A wonderful experience!! Nora came to our house and checked and vaccinated our four rabbits in a very kind and caring way. We appreciate the service and the personalized attention!! <3

In March of this year, I was looking for a veterinarian who could help us with all the necessary paperwork to travel with our dog, a Bichon Maltese, outside the European Union, specifically to Latin America. We had planned a trip of several months and wanted him to be able to come with us. Searching online, we found TomVets and contacted them.
From the beginning, they explained the entire process to us. We filled out several forms with information about our trip, the documents we had at the time, and our dog's details. Once they reviewed our case, they created a personalized plan outlining all the steps we needed to take and the deadlines for each.
They helped us throughout the entire process, including the rabies serology test, checking vaccinations and all the documentation, deworming, obtaining the health certificate, and later, processing the necessary paperwork through CEXGAN. They were also very attentive to the registration and microchip to ensure all the information matched correctly before the trip, and they helped us complete and properly record all the necessary information in his European passport and veterinary documentation.
Something else we really appreciated was that the visits were at home. Our dog tends to get quite nervous when he goes to the vet or a consultation, so being able to have the visits at home, in his own environment and comfort zone, made the whole process much more comfortable for both him and us.
The veterinarians were very professional, and the service throughout the entire process was very personal. I could always ask them any questions I had via WhatsApp, and they also followed up to ensure we were completing each step correctly and within the established deadlines. Finally, we were able to travel from Barcelona to Peru, our destination, with our dog and without any problems with his documentation. We were there for a few months, and it was a relief to be able to travel with everything properly prepared from Spain. As a recommendation for anyone thinking of traveling with their pet outside the European Union, I would advise starting to plan well in advance, as different countries may require various procedures that can be quite time-consuming. We started organizing our trip in March for a July travel, and doing so several months ahead allowed us to have everything prepared and complete each procedure within the deadlines without stress.

Many thanks to the entire TomVets team for your help, attention, and support throughout the entire process so that our dog could accompany us on this trip.
Super patient and super friendly. They explain everything very clearly and make you feel very welcome. We will definitely be using them again whenever we can from now on!

The best service for your pet if you want to take them abroad. They help you with everything, answer all your questions, and are attentive throughout the entire process. I recommend them 100%. The veterinarians are very caring with pets. I was truly very happy and at ease; they are the best. Thank you so much, TomVets!
I had not made a home visit and my cat has been very calm despite being a cat with a character. The vet is very professional and very respectful.

I was so lucky to find these professionals through an online ad, completely by chance, right after my cat had been to my vet twice for vaccinations and they couldn't get him vaccinated. I'll definitely be back; no more taking my cat to the vet stressed out!
Nora is an excellent veterinarian, with a lot of patience with shy pets like mine.

Tom was with us during one of the most difficult moments: saying goodbye to Kai after so many years with us. From the very first moment, he was incredibly sensitive, empathetic, and caring, both with Kai and with us.

He made the entire process calm, respectful, and as peaceful as possible in such a painful situation. He took his time, explained each step to us, and treated Kai with immense love and gentleness until the very end.

In moments like these, it is so incredibly valuable to find a professional who not only knows what they are doing but also understands how important that little dog is to his family. We will always be so grateful for how he supported us during his farewell.
Wonderful people and service! For our cats having the consultation at home made it a lot easier without any stress for the animal.

I had the worst experience anyone who loves another living being can have: watching my cat suffer for 20 hours until euthanasia was the only option… and all because of the vet's "mistake" in prescribing a tranquilizer (BONQAT) to my almost 18-year-old cat without considering her age or the treatments she'd had in the last four months, which were for a runny nose and ear discomfort.

In March, my cat had a complete checkup at a clinic and was incredibly healthy for her age, including her kidneys!

So in May, I decided to use the mobile vet service TomVets to avoid stressing her out, as she still had a runny nose.

When I started antibiotic treatment, my kitten's behavior changed completely… but she continued eating, albeit much less, drinking water, and showed absolutely no signs of pain… pain that appeared 24 hours after I gave her the tranquilizer so they could draw blood for a blood test.

I personally asked the vet if it wasn't dangerous to give her this tranquilizer, and she replied: "BONQAT is very safe!"
What I witnessed in the last 48 hours of my kitten's life caused me to experience post-traumatic stress, and irrationally, instead of blaming her for her mistake, I blamed the tranquilizer.

I contacted "them" via WhatsApp, and the person I believe to be the manager seemed completely unsympathetic to the situation.

My heart is broken because I was the only person my kitten trusted, and I feel terrible for having trusted the vet's knowledge.

The video is from 3 days before I gave her the damned "very safe" tranquilizer that completely weakened her delicate kidneys.

My response: You have no idea how awful it sounds to think my suffering is so bad… I'm suffering because my kitten would be here if she hadn't taken that damned Bonqat!
Surely the commission for prescribing this "tranquilizer," which costs almost 50 euros, must be very good.
Besides, almost all the information you have is wrong: My kitten had a complete check-up at a clinic in March, and the blood test results showed she was perfectly healthy!
I showed this test to Cleydi. I opted for your home care service to treat her runny nose, and it was at the beginning of this treatment that my kitten started losing her appetite… And 4 weeks later, she had to be euthanized to end the suffering caused by the tranquilizer's side effects.

The blood test was necessary, but the correct approach would have been to prescribe something much milder given her current condition, which was not the same as in March.
The correct approach would also have been to admit mistakes instead of making up arguments to justify their "work." There was no attention throughout the entire process, nor was there any "very thorough daily follow-up." I was the one who had to make contact and request phone calls. Only on the day of the euthanasia was there proper dedication to performing the procedure.

(With individual cremation, the cost was almost 500 euros.) And that "body condition score 2/5" claim is inaccurate. Look at the video of my cat eating solid food three days before the tragedy. From then on, she was eating twice as much as she had been during the previous three weeks. Furthermore, she has never had diarrhea in her life. She wasn't a dying kitten as you tried to portray her.

I hope my review serves as a warning to tutors who need more delicate and differentiated attention 🙏🏻

The experience with Tom at home was exceptional. We contacted them because our large dog, Rex, couldn't be carried down the stairs because he had stopped moving his hind legs. Tom assessed him and prescribed treatment, but unfortunately, things didn't go well. We were able to say goodbye as a family, which was the best thing for him. Tom respected our timing completely. Despite not knowing them beforehand, they inspired confidence in us, especially during such a difficult time.
Excellent home delivery service

I absolutely do not recommend Tomvets. After trusting them twice, I was completely disappointed and feel scammed. What they advertise on Instagram has nothing to do with the reality of their home service. I've wasted almost €200 on negligent visits.

First visit (August 8, 2023): I booked a trivalent vaccine, check-up, and nail trim for my kitten. The vet arrived extremely late, didn't have the vaccination record (she wrote everything down on a random piece of paper), didn't examine the cat, and refused to trim her nails, claiming that "she wouldn't let me."

Second visit (January 21, 2026): A vet named Oscar came. He not only harshly criticized his former colleague, but he also dropped a bombshell: what they injected my cat with in August 2023 wasn't a vaccine, but a supplement, and he charged me an exorbitant price for it. Oscar's treatment of my cat was shameful. He chased her all over the house with zero empathy, demonstrating a worrying lack of feline handling skills. To top it off, he filled out the vaccination record incorrectly and, although he promised to let us know about the second dose in a month, he never did.
In the end, I had to go to my local vet, and the difference is abysmal: impeccable service, professionalism, and genuine empathy. If you're looking for a vet to make house calls, look for anyone but TomVets. They have no idea how to treat a cat, and their professional ethics leave much to be desired. UPDATE — September 2026: TomVets responded publicly to this review, stating that their veterinary director, Tommaso, would contact me via WhatsApp to discuss the details and take appropriate action. I never received that contact.
Today, after I publicly shared my experience again on their Instagram, TomVets contacted me privately and asked for my email address. I gave it to them, but then they stopped responding to my messages and finally blocked me on Instagram.

Therefore, to this day I still have not received any explanation or solution from TomVets.

I was not happy with the way this clinic communicated via message.

I had an appointment booked for September 18th, but I canceled it today, September 17th, after leaving work, around 8:00 PM.

I was surprised to be informed that I had to pay €39 for canceling the appointment. I find this charge disproportionate, especially since I was never informed beforehand about this penalty, nor was I presented with a quote or terms and conditions that clearly stated that the cancellation would incur a cost.

I believe this type of information should be communicated to the patient clearly and in advance.

For my part, I will not return to this clinic and will look for another one where the terms and conditions are more transparent.

On September 18th, they are still insisting that I have to pay €39 for canceling the appointment. At 8:00 PM on September 18th, they are still sending messages to me.

Be careful with this clinic and make sure to ask about their cancellation policy and any potential additional charges beforehand.

Thank you very much.

A completely disappointing experience. I paid €35 ​​for supposed expert advice, and in practice, I received general information that I already had and that two other veterinarians had explained to me in exactly the same way, and for FREE.

To make matters worse, I received contradictory information on one of the important aspects of the procedure.

On August 3rd, I wrote to them explaining my dissatisfaction in detail, and to this day, I still haven't received a response. Not an explanation, not a solution, not even the most basic customer service.

Charging €35 for basic information that other professionals offer for free and then ignoring the customer when they complain is deplorable.

I would not use this service again, nor would I recommend it.
They found me an appointment the same day I requested it. The vet who saw her was very attentive and empathetic. In the end, it was nothing serious, but I was relieved by how quickly they responded.

Despite our pain, it was a relief to say goodbye to our little one at home. We always wanted her to leave her home, where she had always lived. 😞 Thank you to TomVets and Óscar for their empathy during our time of grief. …

Everything was perfect. I needed to get the paperwork done to travel to Argentina with my cat, and they handled everything quickly and efficiently. A veterinarian came to my home on the agreed-upon day and completed everything in just a few minutes; I traveled without any problems.
Very happy with the service and the results...highly recommended, thank you

It takes a lot of patience to get my three elusive cats vaccinated. Since we can't fit them in carriers, home visits are our only option for vaccinations, and we really appreciate this service and the friendly treatment from the veterinarians who come to visit us.

Five stars aren't enough! He visited my one-and-a-half-year-old cat, and the experience couldn't have been better. He demonstrated great knowledge and incredible empathy from the very first moment. What I liked most was that he wasn't in any rush: he gave the little guy his space so he could sniff all his things and feel safe. Since he didn't have to travel, my cat didn't suffer any stress; the whole process was like being with family. Tommaso was super friendly, and we will definitely continue to use him and the entire Tomvets team. For those of us with cats, a house call vet is something I 100% recommend. The price of the visit is totally worth it when you eliminate your companion's stress and can have the consultation at your own pace, literally like at home. A wonderful service!
A 10! Flora came to my house and managed to examine my 2 cats. Something no vet had managed to do in many years. A great treatment, not stressful at all for them, or for me! 100% recommended.
Very friendly and efficient home veterinarians. Thank you very much for everything.

A few days ago, we had to say goodbye to our cat Paula, who was very old. Although it was a difficult time, Tom's care and kindness made everything much easier. He explained everything he was going to do and treated the animal with great gentleness. The best part was being able to go through this process at home, without the stress of going to a clinic, and with Tom's comforting and calming presence. We were so happy to be with you during this time; it couldn't have been better. Thank you so much from the bottom of our hearts. I recommend you wholeheartedly.
Superb service, they helped me from beginning to end with all the documentation for taking my cats to Brazil. 100% recommend.
Nora was incredibly kind to Xena, she treated the kitten very well and was very affectionate with her. Excellent service.

I'm giving two stars to the wonderful Flora, who always treated us and Emmet, our 15-year-old dog, with love and patience. We called on the 17th requesting an emergency vet because our boy was slipping away; we didn't know what was wrong with him. He wasn't responding, he wasn't walking, he just kept vomiting a strange liquid. They sent us, almost reluctantly, on the 18th to an emergency vet, who called us 30 minutes before the scheduled arrival time to say she couldn't come because of a car accident (completely understandable). But TomVets told us they couldn't send anyone else and that they were sorry. My dog ​​had been vomiting for two days—TWO!—without eating or being able to move. We couldn't take him to any hospital because he's a large dog with reduced mobility (that's why we use their home service), and because of our location and living situation, it was impossible for us to transport him. Thank God other vets who couldn't come helped us contact one who could through contacts and WhatsApp groups (something TomVets didn't do or even suggest...), and she saved our Emmet. Flora? 10 out of 10. TomVets' service, as a company? AWFUL.

They arrived on time, helped my dog ​​until the very last minute, without rushing, with affection and understanding, and took care of all the subsequent arrangements. I couldn't have chosen better. Just so grateful. Nuria and Hampus ❤️
Nora came home. She's a lovely vet and has been very patient with my kitten. Everything is great!

We have had the worst experience in more than 70 years of owning pets and working with veterinarians.

We chose TomsVet because of its excellent reviews, hoping our beloved 16-year-old dog, Iggy, could spend his final moments peacefully at home with us.

This was not our first experience with euthanasia. Over the years we have helped several much-loved pets pass peacefully, including four previous home euthanasias. Sadly, this was the only experience that was anything but peaceful.

For months we worked with our regular veterinarian to investigate Iggy’s declining health. We explored every reasonable option, treated a urinary infection, ruled out Cushing’s disease, adjusted his medications and routines, and agonized over whether it was time to let him go. We finally reached the painful conclusion that we were keeping him alive for ourselves rather than for him.

Instead of being met with compassion and support, the veterinarian challenged our decision and argued that our dog’s condition did not justify euthanasia. At one of the most heartbreaking moments of our lives, we found ourselves having to defend a decision that had already been made after months of careful consideration.

The procedure itself was deeply distressing. During the first injection, Iggy cried out repeatedly, something we had never experienced with any of our previous pets. The veterinarian then had difficulty placing the intravenous line for the final medication and had to make a second attempt. What should have been a peaceful farewell became a traumatic experience that will stay with us.

Because we believe mistakes and difficult situations can be discussed openly, we did not immediately post a public review. Instead, we contacted TomsVet and invited them to meet with us for a constructive debrief. We were not seeking compensation or an argument—only understanding, accountability, and the opportunity to help prevent another family from having the same experience.

We contacted the company on three separate occasions. We were initially told our concerns would be passed on, and later told that someone would contact us “when he has time.” After waiting, following up, and even providing a deadline for a response, we were simply ignored.

It is this lack of professionalism after the event that has convinced us to share our experience publicly.

Every family deserves to feel supported, heard, and cared for when saying goodbye to a beloved companion. Sadly, that was not our experience.

Based on our experience, we cannot recommend TomsVet for end-of-life care.
They're fabulous, I personally love them a lot. They're very professional and my cat doesn't experience as much stress, which is the most important thing for me.

Excellent service: they examined my two kittens, answered all my questions, and reviewed their latest test results. It's very convenient that they come to your home, especially for kittens, who are more reluctant to leave their familiar surroundings.
We tried the home visit service for the first time and we were delighted. Nora provided excellent service. She took her time to calm the cats before vaccinating them and giving them a quick check-up.

Today, we said goodbye to our little grandmother. I wanted to thank Tom Vets, especially Tom for the great humanity, professionalism, tenderness and sensitivity that he has given us today. He has been a very important part of this process and within the pain we are carrying, his presence and his humanity have made it a little easier. Thank you Tom for accompanying Ona on her last journey, we could not have chosen a nicer veterinarian. I would also like to thank the sensitivity of Nora and Clàudia, two beautiful people who have understood the difficult situation at all times. I can only say words of gratitude, it is clear that taking you as veterinarians has been one of the most beautiful things we have done for our family. Thank you ❤️

Excellent professionalism, care, and attention, especially from Óscar and Tom, who monitor and ensure the well-being of our cat Luna.

Thank you to the entire TomVets team for providing this wonderful and much-needed home visit service, which is incredibly comforting.
Nora took wonderful care of Forest. She advised us on what was best for our dog and his condition. We loved her kindness and professionalism.

Tom was really kind and supporting in a time of need. We had to make the very difficult choice to let our beloved cat go, his reassurance, that we are doing what's best for her, the way he explained the process from the beginning and how gently he handled our cat helped us to have the best possible last moments with her, in our home, in peace.

Fuet, I'm thiking about you every day. I hope you know that we did everyting in your interest and you are very much loved forever.I miss you so much.

Today my Rocco passed away at 15 years and 10 months old. The vet's euthanasia service was incredibly sensitive, and he explained the most difficult moment to us very well. Thank you, Óscar Garcia Cordero!
Good place, good food and service
I felt great knowing that my cat didn't have to stress about going to the vet. Tomasso is very respectful and everything went very well. I recommend him.
Very happy, and my boys are delighted.

Today was vaccination day, and my Boby was very calm and had no problems at all. I'm absolutely delighted with TOMVETS; they're very caring with the pets and gave me lots of advice. I'm very happy. I highly recommend TOMVETS because pets stay in their own home with their owners during their check-up. Go for it, don't hesitate! THANK YOU SO MUCH!!!!! ❤️

Excellent customer service. I've been very well advised from the moment I requested information on how to proceed with the paperwork to travel with my dog, and not only that, but also how to register my pet in Spain and get vaccinations. I highly recommend them.
Tomaso was very attentive and had a lot of patience. We will repeat!
Perfect

Thank you so much for coming to euthanize Nayra, our dog with metastasis. Despite it being a difficult moment, I found Nora to be very kind and professional. It's clear she loves animals, and she couldn't have done a better job. I 100% recommend this service. Although it was painful, I felt very comforted seeing what a great professional and kind person she was to my dog ​​on her last day. Thank you so much; I will always remember it.
They helped us with our baby Jack. The vet, Cleydi, was very patient and took care of us in the best way possible. Thank you 💗
Finally, my cat can see a vet and avoid the stress and fear of going. Thanks to Tom for his professionalism and calm demeanor.
I only have words of gratitude and especially for Nora for helping us during the process and mourning of my beloved dog Canela. Very, very good!

On January 28th, we said goodbye to our beloved Muffy. He was 16 years old. Two and a half years ago, he was diagnosed with two lung tumors. Initially, he was given six months to live, but he kindly stayed to care for us for two more years. It was a very difficult decision, but the time had come to let him go and end his suffering. Our veterinarian told us about TomVets. Amidst the pain we felt, hiring them was the best decision we could have made. They explained every step of the process to us in detail. On the day he passed away, we were all by his side. He was in his home, on his sofa, wrapped in his blanket, surrounded by his family. One by one, we were all able to express how much happiness and love he left us with. And finally, he passed away peacefully, wrapped in his arms and loved, just as he had always lived. He couldn't have had a better farewell. Our deepest gratitude to Valeria for her sensitivity and respect.
Everything was perfect. The service was outstanding. Cleydi was very professional and also very friendly.
I am delighted with the way the professional who came worked. My Happy didn't even notice the puncture. Thank you
An efficient service with facilities for those of us who can't take our cat to a clinic. The vet was friendly and professional. I recommend it.

I want to express my deepest gratitude to the team for their patience, guidance, explanations, and support during a very difficult time for us.

They helped us navigate Penny's passing with great respect, sensitivity, and love. Thanks to them, she was able to leave in the best possible way: at home, peacefully, in her own space, surrounded by her familiar scents, her belongings, and all our love.

I also greatly appreciate the conversations and comments that helped us feel a little more comforted during such a delicate moment.

From the bottom of my heart, thank you so much for your compassionate care, your guidance, and for taking such good care of Penny and us.
Cleydi provided excellent service and was very loving with our kitten. Highly recommended.

After 22 years with my life partner (because we've been together for half of my life), the idea that his last days, moments... would be away from his safe and familiar space felt strange to me, and I also didn't want him to get stressed or feel disoriented... Thank you for coming home and bringing us peace of mind.

Very happy with the formality and organization of the company as well as WITH THE PROFESSIONALISM OF THE TWO VETERINARIANS who came to my house, I take my hat off to them for their qualities of courage and loving treatment of pets at home.

We felt very supported; they facilitated all the sensitive and difficult details involved in passing on our beloved dog, Gus. Tom treated him and us with exceptional care. We held an intimate ceremony at our home to say our final goodbyes. We are grateful for the recommendation; it was the best way to do it.

Nora came to visit my cat today.
I was very happy; she answered all my questions.
I want to highlight her professionalism and patience with my cat.
Thank you.
Excellent service, punctual, and the price was great. It was the first time they'd visited my cat, and they treated her wonderfully. Highly recommended, without a doubt.
Impeccable service: punctuality, professionalism, very good treatment of the animals and a very complete visit, without rushing.

The service is punctual and very professional. We were attended to by an experienced veterinarian who knew how to control our cat, who does not have a docile character, at all times. A very complete and pleasant visit without having to travel. 100% recommended

My cats are elderly and have a very hard time when we go to the vet. One of them got sick, so we decided to contact TomVets. The service was excellent, both from the vet who came to our house, who was so kind, and from the way we contacted them via WhatsApp to schedule the appointment. I highly recommend them!!!!! It was stress-free, a calm visit, with the vet dedicating time and affection to both the cats and us, which was incredibly reassuring.

Incredible experience, words can't describe it better. The peace of mind of knowing your furry friend is in expert hands and the peace of mind of not having to travel in this heatwave... THANK YOU SO MUCH!!
Thank you so much for everything! We arrived at our destination without any problems. Excellent advice and perfect management!

This is actually the first time I've used this service; Nora came.
She was very nice, and my cats loved it.
I really appreciate not having to move them, which is stressful for them, so I'm delighted.
The service was great, and everything went perfectly. I highly recommend it 🤗
Excellent visit!! Quick and clear communication via WhatsApp. The vet was very sweet and kind 😊 We will definitely use their home visit service again. Thank you 😻 …

Despite it being an incredibly difficult time, I am so grateful that I was able to euthanize my cat at home. It gave us the opportunity to say goodbye to her peacefully, surrounded by her family and in the familiar environment where she felt safe.
Excellent service and the care my dog ​​received was outstanding. Highly recommended.
Super easy to schedule and I think it's reasonably priced considering they come to your home! I had a great experience with Nora specifically. She was super calm and prepared.
Great! They arrived very quickly and took excellent care of my cat, who improved significantly in the following days. A good option when you have pets that get very stressed when leaving the house.

We cannot recommend Tomvets enough. They are always so helpful, super kind with our very nervous rescue dog, and very convenient as our dog detests going into a vets, so they always come to our home which puts our dog more at ease. Fantastic service, thank you Tomsvets.
Great service and excellent work with the animals. This is the second time they've come to my house to vaccinate my dogs, and it's really convenient. I highly recommend them! 👌 …
Super careful and attentive with animals (and humans!)
Oscar has been a very good professional, friendly and efficient. Very satisfied with his service

I am very grateful for the services provided by TomVests.
Efficiency, customer service, and punctuality.

Saying goodbye to Anouk was quick and easy. The veterinarian who came made me feel calm and supported throughout, and my little dog passed away peacefully and without pain. They were incredibly empathetic. The person who was taking Anouk didn't come to our house until she had left us.
It was a difficult moment, but thanks to them, I remember it with gratitude and peace.

They were a huge help in the process of saying goodbye to our pet, and although it was a very difficult time, being able to do it at home in a calm and familiar environment for him was a great help.

Thank you again to the TomVets team.

We used Tom Vets while traveling through Barcelona on our boat. They were able to come directly to the marina to take blood for our dog's rabies test, which we required to continue our travels. The service was convenient and highly professional. I completely recommend them to other travelers.

Flora, a very nice girl, came to administer the lethal dose to my cat. She was very kind and caring throughout, without any unnecessary formality; she ensured that the unpleasant experience of watching them come to put down your pet didn't become a cold, soulless formality. She was a model of composure in a delicate emotional situation, always respecting my privacy, showing empathy, and without making me uncomfortable at all when I was able to express my feelings about the loss. Very affordable for the service they offer; even more so when compared to what some specialized hospitals charge.

Our kitten wouldn't let anyone pick him up, so a very experienced veterinarian came to our house and was able to vaccinate and examine him without any problems.
Thank you so much, we're delighted with this home service.

I absolutely loved the service you provided. You've gained new clients because we'll definitely be using your services again thanks to your kindness, the care you give our furry friends, and so much more. Thank you for everything!

Thank you, TomVets! The best by far. We needed EU passports for our two small dogs and they made the entire process easy. Our dogs have a lot of anxiety with vet visits so having in home appointments was so nice. I can’t recommend them enough!
We've had several visits with veterinarian Tomaso, and he's been lovely, empathetic, and a very good professional. We're always grateful. 100% recommended.

I wish I didn't have to leave this review; that would mean my kitten would still be with us. But I wanted to highlight the wonderful care and compassion of Tommaso (the veterinarian), who made room for us that same day because our kitten's condition deteriorated rapidly in a matter of hours, and we didn't want her to suffer another night. Thanks to Tommaso, we were able to say goodbye to her at home. She was very peaceful, and despite the difficult situation, he guided us with his gentle touch, love, and evident respect for animals. She couldn't have had a better farewell. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts; we will always be grateful for your gentle care and for making our kitten's final moments as comfortable as possible.

I had to put my kitten down, and I didn't want to do it outside the house because he gets extremely stressed in the carrier, and I didn't want him to suffer any more. The vet was excellent, friendly, and very compassionate. 100% recommended.

We would give more stars if we could! The team helped us with moving our dog back to Australia which was a very stressful process but the guys helped us SO much and knew the entire process - wouldn’t speak more highly of TomVets - thanks again guys for getting Sammy back!

Both times I've called them, the vets have been very patient with my cat and have always answered all my questions. It's true that the visit is more expensive because they have to travel, but it's worth it for me since he doesn't leave the house and neither of us gets stressed. 🤗 …

Everything was great. I should have called TomVets sooner. My kittens were relaxed throughout the visit and didn't even realize they were getting vaccinated 🤭 Before, every vet visit was always a huge stress for them. …
